sentences.text: Mr. S. Pandey, Dy. Govt. Advocate for the State.

Heard on I.A. No.1/2025, application for
suspension of sentences and grant of bail to applicant.

Learned counsel for applicant submits that by the impugned judgment dated 8.7.2025, applicant stands convicted under Sections 420 & 408 of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo SI for 01 year and fine of Rs.1,000/- for each offence respectively, with usual default stipulations.

He submits that applicant was on bail during pendency of trial as also appeal and after passing of impugned judgment convicting and sentencing the applicant in the manner aforementioned,
learned appellate Court has extended the period of bail and bail bonds for a further period of six months and pursuant thereto applicant is on bail as of now.

He submits that applicant is having prima facie good case in his favour and is likely to succeed and there is no likelihood of coming up of this revision for final hearing in near future, hence, the jail sentences imposed upon applicant be suspended and he be released on bail.
On the other hand, counsel for the State opposes the bail application.

Considering the facts and circumstances of case, in particular short sentences imposed upon applicant and that disposal of this revision may take time, I am inclined to suspend substantive sentences imposed upon applicant and release him on bail.
Accordingly, it is directed that execution of substantive jail sentences of applicant shall remain suspended during pendency of this revision and he is directed to be enlarged on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) and a surety bond in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court concerned for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 20.11.2025.

He shall thereafter appear before the trial Court concerned on a date to be given by the Registry of this Court and continue to appear there on all such dates as are given to him by the said Court till final disposal of this revision.
List the matter for final hearing in its due course.

Sd/-
(Parth Prateem Sahu) Judge roshan/-
